name: Demon's Vestibule
description: The five-hundred-step staircase lined with performers leading to Rix Maadi.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Vraska come without her Golgari defenders so she can explain Hekara's death to the Cult.
timeline.quote: If the Cultists wanted an explanation (or demanded vengeance) for the death of Emissary Hekara

timeline.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.
